g.text: Lunar production and chronology functions of Neukum et al. (2001). Synthetic detector on 1.5 m pixels: recall 50 % at 7 px rising to 95 %, 7 % diameter error, false
positives near the resolution limit. Completeness and false-positive rates measured by injection on a separate 30 km² labelled set; ages by Poisson maximum
likelihood in 10 bins per decade. Seed 5153.
